name: Sticky Gaze
source:
Lera had always been odd. A ritual gone wrong in the abandoned school pool left her missing – and her friends must uncover the cause.

[From [url=https://myarvah.itch.io/sticky-gaze]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
莱拉向来性情古怪。在废弃的学校泳池里举行的一场仪式出了差池，导致她自此下落不明——而她的朋友们必须查明背后的原因。

[摘自[url=https://myarvah.itch.io/sticky-gaze]itch.io[/url]]
